fix.item: Darkened the default light-mode header background (--rwd-head, #eaeaea → #d6dbe0), it was lighter than the table's own border color (#dddddd) and nearly indistinguishable from the (already very subtle) row stripes (#f8f8f8/#f9f9f9), so the header blended into the body instead of standing out. Dark mode's header color is unaffected. Sites that already set their own "Header background color" in the Appearance settings (v2.0.33) are unaffected either way, since that always overrides the built-in default.

Added a rwd-truncate opt-in class as an alternative to horizontal scrolling: every cell's content is cut to one line with an ellipsis instead of overflowing sideways, with the full value available via a native title tooltip (hover or keyboard focus). No scrollbar at all, the trade-off is needing to hover a truncated value to read it in full. Independent of rwd-scroll-only: a rwd-truncate table still stacks into cards normally below the breakpoint, only affecting the wide, non-stacked view.

title is set via the existing nested-table-safe ownCells() helper (not a deep querySelectorAll, which could reach into a nested table's own cells) and never overwrites an attribute already present, an author-supplied tooltip is left alone.

Verified via headless render on the same real-world report-table shape as rwd-sticky-col: a 12-column table that previously needed horizontal scroll now measures zero overflow, a long cell (Kmenovy_utvar) gets a title with its full value, a short cell (Os_Cislo) does too, and the table still stacks into cards at a narrow viewport. A pre-set custom title on a cell survives re-running enhance(). Added as permanent Playwright regression tests.

Added a rwd-sticky-col opt-in class: freezes the first column in place while scrolling a wide table horizontally, so you don't lose track of which row you're looking at (e.g. a user-rights report with 10+ columns, where the ID/name is in the first column). Combine with rwd-scroll-only, or use alone on any table that already scrolls (e.g. via the min-width setting). Real-world case: a com_fgreports output table using this plugin, cards on mobile as expected, but plain horizontal scroll on desktop with no way to tell which row you'd scrolled to.

Each row state (header, zebra stripe, hover) gets its own explicit background on the sticky cell, so scrolled-past content doesn't show through underneath it. Scoped to :not(.is-stacked), has no effect once a table is stacked into cards, where "first column" isn't a visual concept anymore.

Verified via headless render: the sticky cell reports position: sticky before scrolling, and after scrolling the wrap 300px horizontally, the cell's own left edge still measures within 1px of the wrap's left edge, a genuine pin, not just the CSS property being present. A table with rwd-scroll-only but no rwd-sticky-col is confirmed unaffected. Added as permanent Playwright regression tests.
Added php_minimum7.4/php_minimum to updates.xml (a standard Joomla update-feed element, checked alongside targetplatform when Joomla decides whether to offer an update).

Considered "lazy wrap" (only create .rwd-table-wrap once a table drops below the breakpoint) and declined it: the wrap also provides the scroll container the min-width setting and rwd-scroll-only class depend on for wide, non-stacking tables, deferring it would break horizontal scroll for those. The DOM cost being saved (one div per table, once) is too small to be worth that trade-off.
Added a "Presets" section to README.md: three field-value combinations to copy into the settings screen by hand, Minimal, Full, and Performance. Documentation only.

Added a rwdTables:enhanced custom event for integrating with other scripts: fires once per table, right after that table is fully processed (document.addEventListener('rwdTables:enhanced', e => ...), e.detail.table).

Added a rwd-scroll-only opt-in class for tables where stacking into cards doesn't make sense (e.g. a comparison matrix), table class="responsiv rwd-scroll-only" never stacks, stays a real table, and scrolls horizontally instead. Per-table, not a global setting.

Added dir="rtl" support: replaced hardcoded text-align: left/right with logical start/end (desktop header, caption, th[scope=row], the mobile card's value). CSS Grid already followed direction on its own. Known gap: the scroll-shadow indicator isn't RTL-aware (browsers measure scrollLeft differently under RTL), only matters for an RTL page also using the min-width scroll setting.

The scrollable region's accessible name now uses aria-labelledby pointing at the caption's id (generated if missing, existing ids never overwritten) instead of copying its text into aria-label. Falls back to aria-label when there's no caption.

Added an "Appearance" fieldset (border/text/header/label color, card radius, card shadow) so a quick branding tweak doesn't need a custom.css edit, outputs a small inline :root{...} block only when at least one field is set. Dropped --rwd-accent-soft from the plan after finding it was dead CSS (defined, never consumed); used --rwd-label instead. Covers the light palette only.

Added an opt-in "Compose multi-level labels" setting: for a grouped header (Cena split into hodina/km), the mobile card's label can now show the full path (Cena › hodina) instead of just the leaf column name. Off by default; separator configurable (default › ).
Added de-DE, cs-CZ, and pl-PL translations, alongside en-GB and sk-SK.

Release builds now include minified CSS/JS (scripts/minify.sh: terser + clean-css, with source maps). No joomla.asset.json/PHP changes needed, Joomla's Web Asset Manager automatically prefers a .min. file when present. Real size reduction: JS 22.8KB → 6.7KB, main CSS 16.8KB → 6.4KB, legacy CSS 2.0KB → 0.85KB.

The opt-in "Watch for dynamically added tables" MutationObserver is now debounced (50ms), so a burst of DOM changes (a page builder inserting lots of content at once) triggers one enhance() pass instead of many.

Fixed a Slovak typo (úplně → úplne); renamed the script Web Asset to .tables-script for clarity; added declare(strict_types=1); documented .responsiv-fixed and .rwd-nowrap in README.md; made the autoClass container selector configurable (auto_class_selector) instead of hardcoded to Joomla core markup.
Added a Playwright test suite (tests/) covering the P1 bugs below plus historical regressions (17 tables across 5 fixtures), running automatically via .github/workflows/tests.yml on every push/PR.
Fixed the release workflow: build-check.sh needed bash build-check.sh, not ./build-check.sh, the executable bit didn't survive a Windows commit.

Added automated releases (.github/workflows/release.yml): pushing a version tag now bumps all version files, regenerates changelog.xml, packages the install ZIP, and creates the GitHub Release automatically. Cutting a release is now just: add a CHANGELOG.md entry, push, then tag and push the tag.

Joomla's Extensions: Update screen can now show this plugin's changelog directly (changelogurl + changelog.xml, generated from this file by scripts/build_changelog_xml.py). Took several iterations (2.0.18,2.0.23) to get right: the correct changelog XML schema, then discovering Joomla's changelog viewer doesn't re-escape text before displaying it, so literal tag references, ampersands, and em/en dashes in a bullet's own text could all break the rendering, all are now stripped/replaced before escaping.

Documented a known trade-off: the mobile card's generated-content label can be read twice by some screen readers alongside the role="columnheader" association. Added an opt-in "Load only on com_content pages" setting (off by default) to skip loading CSS/JS on pages with no table.

Reverted 2.0.14's font-size: 0.9375rem back to a fixed 15px, confirmed as a real regression on a production site whose template resets the html root font-size, making the rem value resolve smaller than intended.
Added print styles (no card shadows, full content visible instead of a clipped scroll area, avoid splitting a card across a page break) and a forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) border rule.
Changed font-size: 15px to 0.9375rem for WCAG 1.4.4 (reverted in 2.0.16, see above). Added validate="options" to all radio/list fields and filter="cmd" to card_style.

Corrected a factual error in a code comment: data-color-scheme is an Atum (admin template) attribute, not something Cassiopeia (the frontend template) sets, Cassiopeia has no built-in dark mode. Dark-mode styling now triggers on Bootstrap 5.3's data-bs-theme="dark" on any ancestor, plus the OS-level prefers-color-scheme fallback. Added color-scheme: light dark so the wrap's own scrollbar matches the active mode.

wrapCellValues() (wraps each cell's content in span class="rwd-value") now runs lazily, only for tables that actually stack, instead of for every table regardless of whether it ever needs to, the DOM mutation could break a template's or script's own selectors on tables that never stack at all.
ensureWrap() no longer throws if a table is detached from the document (parentElement === null), returns the table itself instead, so one bad table can't abort processing for every table after it.
observeWidth()'s ResizeObserver (and its window resize fallback) now disconnects itself when its target leaves the DOM, fixing a memory leak on pages that dynamically swap tables in and out.

Added an opt-in "Watch for dynamically added tables" setting (off by default): turns on a MutationObserver so a table injected later via AJAX gets enhanced automatically instead of needing a manual window.rwdTablesEnhance() call.
Fixed two (or more) tables sharing one .table-wrapper div ending up with a single shared stacking/resize state instead of each getting its own.

Added role="region" and an accessible name (from the table's caption, or a translated fallback) to the scrollable wrap, so a screen reader doesn't announce an unlabelled Tab stop. Fixed plugin language strings not loading on the frontend at all (needed an explicit loadLanguage() call).

Added a "Minimum table width (px)" setting: without it, a wide table in the gap between the stacking breakpoint and full width just squeezed its columns unreadably instead of stacking or scrolling. Setting a minimum width makes it scroll instead, activating the existing (previously dead-in-practice) scroll-shadow indicator.
Fixed applyLabels() shifting every cell's label one column to the left in any row following a td rowspan="2" in the table body, a real price could show up under the wrong column name on mobile.

Fixed a table with no real thead (a common TinyMCE-authored pattern, trth as the first row inside tbody) rendering its header row as its own near-empty card, and giving those cells the wrong ARIA role (row header instead of column header).
Fixed th scope="row" as the first cell of a body row staying display: table-cell in stacked mode, rendering as a narrow half-width strip instead of spanning the card as its header line.

Fixed a long text value (a note, not just a short price) overflowing the mobile card sideways instead of wrapping. Values now wrap by default; added an opt-in rwd-nowrap class for values that should always stay on one line.
Desktop table header font-size increased from 0.85em to 0.95em, was noticeably small.

Rebranded into the FG series as plg_system_fgresponsivetables (namespace, language files, media paths, display name). Functionally identical to the pre-rebrand 1.9.7: stacks table.responsiv into labelled, accessible cards on narrow screens, with admin-configurable breakpoint, card style, optional float-clearing, and an opt-in legacy.css for older sites' generically-named helper classes. Added an extension update server (updates.xml).
